description:

description:
Check out the latest Melon Sandbox trailer to see what's coming with the map Update 35.0, which brings the Lava and Volcano maps to the ragdoll physics mobile game. In addition to acid pits and underwater caves, players can now explore, create, and cause chaos in two new lava-themed maps. The update also introduces lava tiles, and players can use them–alongside other environmental tiles such as water and acid–to create custom maps. Melon Sandbox is available now on iOS, Android, and the browser, and the new update is out now.

With the latest update, try to overcome flimsy physics and reach the top of the new volcano map, but challenges await, including lava bombs and scorching smoke, along with high heat and density slowly impacting your items. On the lava pool map, certain items won’t survive the high temperatures, so being strategic with your materials is key.

#ign #gaming
title: Melon Sandbox - Official 'Lava and Volcano Maps' Update Trailer

author: IGN
description:
For a guy who was seemingly killed off in his debut movie appearance, Darth Maul has enjoyed a surprisingly long and vibrant career as a Star Wars villain. 1999’s Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace turned out to be just the beginning of Maul’s story, with the character returning to prominence in the animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars, where his battle cry came to echo across Star Wars fandom.

Suffice it to say, if you only watch the Star Wars movies, you’re missing out on a lot when it comes to Darth Maul. But that’s where we come in. As this iconic ex-Sith Lord prepares to star in his very own animated series, Maul: Shadow Lord, we’re here to break down his story in The Clone Wars and its spinoffs and explain what you need to know to enjoy the new series.

Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord is created by Dave Filoni and stars Sam Witwer, Gideon Adlon, Wagner Moura, and Richard Ayoade. The series premieres on Disney+ on April 6, 2026.

#ign
title: Darth Maul's Story So Far: What to Know Before Watching Maul - Shadow Lord
